comment: 45yo male lifelong personal non-smoker (zero pack-years), married to active 1-pack-per-day smoker for 22 years — sustained household ETS exposure ≥10y. Childhood / in-utero ETS exposure additionally documented (both parents indoor smokers 1980-95). Workplace smoke-free since 2000. No current lung-cancer diagnosis. ETS (environmental tobacco smoke / passive smoking) IARC Group 1 (Monograph 83, 2004; reaffirmed) and US Surgeon General-confirmed cause of lung cancer in non-smokers (2006 + 2014 reports). Hackshaw 1997 + Stayner 2007 meta-analyses: adult non-smoker household ETS ~20-25% RR increase (RR ~1.20-1.25); childhood/in-utero ETS adds further long-term lung-cancer + asthma signals. KRAS/EGFR mutation enrichment in passive-smoke non-smoker adenocarcinoma cohorts. Engine fires RF-ENVIRONMENTAL-SECONDHAND-SMOKE-LUNG-PREVENTION (any_of: household_ets_exposure_ge_10y:true OR workplace_ets_exposure_ge_10y:true OR spouse_active_smoker:true OR in_utero_or_childhood_ets_exposure:true) and routes to PreventionPlan: standard = cohabitant smoking-cessation support (spouse-directed varenicline / NRT / behavioural) + workplace smoke-free policy enforcement + personal-mitigation guidance + USPSTF LDCT screening eligibility check (likely ineligible — no personal pack-years; symptom-triggered chest imaging instead); alternative = environmental-mitigation counseling alone. Sister to existing patient_secondhand_smoke_household.json — male-spouse-of-smoker axis (vs female-spouse axis in existing case). Validates v0.3 environmental pilot. Anchored DIS-NSCLC.
